## Checklist

- [ ] I edited the **JSON sources**, not the generated `README.md` files.
- [ ] I ran `python3 scripts/validate.py --links` and it passed.
- [ ] I ran `python3 scripts/build.py` and committed the regenerated files.
- [ ] I opened every URL myself and confirmed the dataset is really there.

## For each dataset added

- [ ] It is publicly obtainable — free, even if an account or accepting terms is required.
- [ ] The host has the right to publish it (not a scraped mirror of licensed content).
- [ ] `license` names the actual license, and `license_url` points at the terms.
- [ ] `commercial_use` is `check` rather than `yes` if the terms are mixed or unclear.
- [ ] It is not already listed for this country.
